notes: The underlined name is gone and there is a real Edit Profile button in the header, sitting NEXT TO the name rather than inside it, because mobile.js mirrors that span's text into the mobile title and a child element would put its label there. It opens straight into the editor, since a button that says Edit Profile should not land you on a read-only panel with a second button to find. WHILE WIRING IT I FOUND THE MODAL WAS BURIED ON MOBILE. body.fm-mobile .wrap is position:fixed, which makes it a stacking context, and the overlay ships inside it, so its z-index of 10500 was never being compared against the mobile chrome at 9990 to 9998 at all. The profile would have opened UNDER the top bar and the bottom nav. Identical defect to the drawer bug from 1.3.6.1 and fixed the same way: hoisted to body. Also closed a smaller one, worse in kind than in odds. The cached bio was only cleared on close, so viewing another player, closing, then opening your own while the fetch failed left THEIR text in your editor, one Save from being published under your name. Cleared on open now. CLIENT ONLY. No server change, no restart needed. Hard refresh.
